# Pokémon card surface attribution

The Hero card surface adapts interaction and visual techniques from
[pokemon-cards-css](https://github.com/simeydotme/pokemon-cards-css) by
[simeydotme](https://github.com/simeydotme), released under the MIT License.

The adaptation uses the project’s pointer-driven CSS custom properties,
perspective tilt, layered repeating gradients, radial glare, and blend-mode
approach. The implementation is rewritten for the PokeCrack WebGL journey in
`apps/web/scripts/scene-parts/pokemon-showcase.css` and
`apps/web/scripts/scene-parts/pokemon-runtime.js.txt`; no Svelte component or
upstream card artwork is copied into the application.

Upstream source and license:

- https://github.com/simeydotme/pokemon-cards-css
- https://github.com/simeydotme/pokemon-cards-css/blob/main/LICENSE

Pokémon names, marks, and card-inspired presentation remain unofficial fan
content. PokeCrack does not claim ownership of Pokémon TCG artwork or cards.
